title: Approval Period of a Standard Non-Formulary Exception (Formulary Benefit)
content:
The approval period of a standard non-formulary exception under the Formulary Benefit is the formulary's standard approval length in months. It is never shorter than one month, and it is a whole number of months.

| Member's Northbridge formulary | Approval period |
|---|---|
| any formulary | the formulary's standard approval length in months, and at least 1 month |

*Worked figure (hypothetical length).* On a formulary whose standard approval length is 12 months, the approval period is 12 months. An approval effective on 15 March 2026 then expires on 14 March 2027.

*Floor.* The period is never below one month, and it is always stated in whole months.
